# tritonctl external-ip

Manage external IPs

Subcommands: list, show, create, release, usage

Usage: `tritonctl external-ip [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl external-ip list

List the project's external IPs

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl external-ip list [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl external-ip show

Show one external IP

Usage: `tritonctl external-ip show [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Name, address, uuid, or prefix

## tritonctl external-ip create

Reserve an external IP in the project

Usage: `tritonctl external-ip create [OPTIONS] --name <NAME>`

- `--name <NAME>` (required)
- `--description <DESCRIPTION>`

## tritonctl external-ip release

Release an external IP. It must not be in use

Usage: `tritonctl external-ip release [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Name, address, uuid, or prefix
- `-n, --dry-run`: Print what would change and stop
- `-y, --yes`: Answer yes to the confirmation. The summary still prints
- `--keep-going`: Keep executing after a step fails

## tritonctl external-ip usage

How many external IPs the tenant holds, and its limit

Usage: `tritonctl external-ip usage [OPTIONS]`
